description: GTFS Realtime is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geschäftsstelle Systemaufgaben Kundeninformation (SBB AG). GTFS Realtime (GTFS-RT) ist eine Erweiterung zu GTFS Static (GTFS). Es wird der Feed "Trip Updates" für die Transportunternehmen angeboten, die Echtzeitdaten einliefern. Verwenden Sie immer das GTFS und das GTFS-RT, die zusammengehören. Ansonsten funktionieren die Referenzen nicht. Der Umgang mit GTFS ist in den weiteren Informationen vermerkt. Coverage: Switzerland. The portal files it under the publisher Geschäftsstelle Systemaufgaben Kundeninformation (SBB AG). It offers 1 resource(s) in SERVICE. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use, the source must be given. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
